decisions.reason: The consumer superfood drink lies far from the engineering core and has not been visible since 2019, so after years without evidence of meeting aspirations the slack is better redirected to the core technology ventures.

Although it has not been visible recently, the modular extensions build directly on the established waste-to-energy business and serve existing customers, so carrying them costs little and does not trigger problemistic search.

Like the withdrawn waste-oil flagship, the plastic-to-fuel plant has shown no visible traction since 2019, and the persistent shortfall against aspirations favours shifting R&D resources to more promising ventures.
